
```{r}
#| label: flagged-by-channel
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 7
# Summed over bins, not averaged: a trial belongs to one bin, so the
# per-bin counts of one (subject, channel) partition that subject's
# trials and add up to the total. n_trials is summed the same way for
# the denominator, which keeps the proportion exact rather than an
# average of per-bin proportions.
flag <- qual %>%
  group_by(dataset, channel) %>%
  summarise(n_flagged = sum(n_flagged, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_trials = sum(n_trials, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct = ifelse(n_trials > 0, 100 * n_flagged / n_trials, NA_real_))

if (nrow(flag) == 0 || sum(flag$n_flagged, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  cat("\nNo channel was flagged in any trial: nothing was rejected per channel.\n\n")
} else {
  fp <- ggplot(flag, aes(x = channel, y = dataset)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = pct), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = flag %>% filter(n_flagged > 0),
              aes(label = n_flagged), size = 2.1, colour = "grey15") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f2f6fa", high = "#c1272d", na.value = "grey90",
                        name = "% of trials", limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    alz_theme_map() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
  print(fp)

  # The same numbers as a short table, because a heat map cannot be
  # read off precisely and these are the rows a reader acts on.
  worst <- flag %>% filter(n_flagged > 0) %>% arrange(desc(pct)) %>% head(12) %>%
    transmute(subject = dataset, channel,
              trials_flagged = n_flagged, trials = n_trials,
              pct_flagged = pct)
  cat(as_raw_html(apa_gt(worst, "Most Frequently Flagged Channels")))

  # Peripherals are named rather than filtered out: their presence high
  # in this table is expected and is not a fault in the recording.
  periph <- flag %>%
    filter(grepl("EOG|EKG|ECG|EMG|GSR|RESP|TRIG|STATUS|MISC", channel, ignore.case = TRUE),
           n_flagged > 0)
  if (nrow(periph) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(paste0("\n%d of the rows above are peripheral channels (%s). An eye or ",
      "heart channel exceeds any threshold chosen for scalp EEG routinely, so a high ",
      "count there reflects the detector having been applied to it rather than a ",
      "problem with the recording. Artefact detection can be restricted to scalp ",
      "channels if that is not wanted.\n\n"),
      nrow(periph), paste(sort(unique(periph$channel)), collapse = ", ")))
  }
}
```
